attachments.origin_landmark: inner surface of the costal groove of the rib above
attachments.insertion_landmark: inner surface of the upper border of the rib below

actions: assist the internal intercostals in depressing the ribs

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Separated from the internal intercostals by the intercostal neurovascular bundle. That plane is the one a chest drain or intercostal block traverses, and it is why the needle is passed over the UPPER border of the lower rib, away from the bundle running in the costal groove above.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

ultrasound_injection_approach.transducer_placement: High-frequency linear probe in longitudinal (parasagittal) orientation over the target intercostal space, most reliably at the posterior axillary line where the rib is most superficial; probe tilted to follow the rib's curvature. This is the standard approach for an intercostal nerve block.
ultrasound_injection_approach.depth_layer: Innermost intercostals are the deepest muscular layer of the intercostal space, separated from the internal intercostals above by the intercostal neurovascular bundle and directly superficial to the parietal pleura -- the thinnest margin of muscle between the needle and the pleura in this region.
ultrasound_injection_approach.identification_cues: Two adjacent hyperechoic rib shadows with the hypoechoic intercostal muscle layers spanning between them; the pleura is seen as a bright sliding line immediately deep to this muscle, moving with respiration -- the closest muscle layer to that pleural line.
structures_at_risk: pleura and underlying lung (pneumothorax) -- the standard named hazard of any needle advanced into the intercostal space, and the most immediate risk given this muscle's direct relationship to the pleura
intercostal vessels running with the nerve just superficial to this muscle
ultrasound_injection_approach.notes: No motor-point/neural-arborization mapping for this muscle's own belly was found in the literature searched. What is well documented is the ultrasound-guided intercostal nerve block, whose target plane (the neurovascular bundle) runs directly superficial to this muscle, immediately superficial to the pleura it protects -- included here because it is the real clinical 'injection approach' relevant to this muscle's neurovascular plane, not a claim of an intramuscular BoNT target.
ultrasound_injection_approach.source: Kannan A, Srinivasan S (2026) 'Image-Guided Interventions for Intercostal Neuralgia: What the Radiologist Needs to Know', J Med Imaging Radiat Oncol, doi:10.1111/1754-9485.70151 -- review of ultrasound- and CT-guided intercostal nerve block/ablation technique; Ajmal S et al (2024) J Bronchology Interv Pulmonol 31(2):183-187, doi:10.1097/LBR.0000000000000937 -- prospective clinical outcomes of intercostal nerve block at the rib angle
